title: Atlas 1.1 — Master Registry
description: Pure index. Points at the canonical/derived registry files that exist; stores no data of its own. Regenerable, but hand-maintained here since the file set changes rarely — tools/registry_guardian.py verifies every ref resolves to a real path on every run.

schema.description: repo-relative path to the schema this file validates against, or null for pre-Atlas-1.1 canonical files that predate a JSON Schema (evidence-registry.json, atlas-state.json) — null is honest here, not a placeholder for a schema that should exist but doesn't

not_yet_implemented.description: named registries proposed but not built in this or any prior PR — kept visible here rather than silently dropped from the design conversation
